compute_accuracy: compute the classification accuracy from predicted probabilities and ground truth labels using JAX
compute_conditional_accuracy: compute the classification accuracy conditioned on a specific subset of labels using JAX
compute_coverage: compute the coverage of confidence sets against ground truth labels using JAX
compute_conditional_coverage: compute the conditional coverage of confidence sets for a subset of examples using JAX
compute_size: compute the average size of confidence sets across all examples using JAX
